reason: A sidebar and bottom-panel workbench for DSH that centralizes navigation, file viewing and editing, terminal, Git, browser, task, chat, and extensibility features.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供集成文件、终端、Git、浏览器、任务和对话功能的侧边栏与底部面板工作台，并支持第三方注册页面和文件查看器。
summaries.en: A DSH sidebar and bottom-panel workbench that integrates files, terminal, Git, browser, task, and chat features while allowing third-party tabs and file viewers to be registered.

capabilities: Registers third-party sidebar tabs and file viewers through an API
Browses and previews files including Markdown, images, HTML, and PDF
Runs a real shell through xterm.js and node-pty
Displays Git history and supports staging, committing, reverting, and diffs
Displays background tasks and sub-agent status
Provides embedded browser tabs and sidebar chat threads
